sql_templates.description: Fetch and join latest insider alerts and bulk deals with technical confirmation.
sql_templates.name: Review_Insider_Bulk_Deals
sql_templates.template:
WITH insider_bulk_activities AS (
                      SELECT 
                          ia.symbol, 
                          ia.entity, 
                          ia.alert_date, 
                          bb.deal_date, 
                          bb.qty, 
                          bb.price, 
                          ss.stage,
                          ss.trading_signal
                      FROM signals.insider_alerts ia
                      JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals bb ON ia.symbol = bb.symbol
                      JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol
                      WHERE 
                          ia.alert_date = (SELECT MAX(alert_date) FROM signals.insider_alerts) 
                          AND bb.deal_date = (SELECT MAX(deal_date) FROM signals.bulk_block_deals)
                          AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
                          AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
                  )
                  SELECT * FROM insider_bulk_activities
                  LIMIT 50;
